headline: ATM strike today: metro, bus and tram at risk 08:45–15:00 and from 18:00; Blue at Assago tonight
taxi: Very high all day outside the 15:00–18:00 guaranteed window; queues at Centrale, Cadorna and in the centre; Assago exits around 23:00.
linate: M4 at risk outside guaranteed hours – take a taxi early; first ISF congress delegates arriving.

headline: ISF World Congress opens at MiCo and Blue play a second night at Assago
taxi: CityLife at congress close (~18:00); Assago exits around 23:00; centre busy on Saturday night.
linate: Busy arrivals of international ISF congress delegates.

headline: ISF World Congress continues at MiCo; Jungle at Assago
taxi: CityLife at congress close; Assago exits around 23:00; evening rain adds demand.
linate: ISF delegates plus Sunday-evening business departures.
weather: Clouding over, light rain in the evening, 8–11°C

headline: ISF World Congress at MiCo and Big Buyer opens
taxi: CityLife around congress and fair closing (~18:00); showers add demand.
linate: Monday business arrivals and ISF delegates; steady traffic.

headline: SIMEI opens at Rho as the ISF Congress closes at MiCo
taxi: Rho at fair closing (~18:00); CityLife busy with Big Buyer and ISF departures.
linate: ISF delegates leaving and international SIMEI buyers arriving.

headline: SIMEI at Rho, Big Buyer's last day and World Business Forum opens at MiCo
taxi: Rho at ~18:00 closing; CityLife morning arrivals and ~18:00 exits.
linate: International SIMEI buyers and World Business Forum attendees arriving.

headline: AutoClassica opens at Rho alongside SIMEI; eve of Friday's general strike, rail stops from 21:00
taxi: Rho at ~18:00 closing; strong evening demand at Centrale and Garibaldi as rail stops from 21:00.
linate: Fair visitors arriving; travellers bringing trips forward ahead of Friday's strike.

headline: CGIL general strike hits taxis, ATM, rail and flights; Muse at Unipol Dome in the evening
taxi: Taxis also on strike – expect very few cars all day; Santa Giulia exits after the Muse show will be very hard.
linate: Flight cancellations likely; M4 and taxis at risk – plan another way to the airport.
